DISTRICT 9 - CGD-GL MSI/General/Miscellaneous

The Coast Guard has transitioned to a visual Maritime Safety Information Products application for the transmission of relevant information previously contained in the published Local Notice to Mariners and Coast Guard Light List. The application, which is accessible at https://www.navcen.uscg.gov/msi, contains the most up to date maritime information overlayed on nautical charts and plotted using latitude and longitude. While the ability to print Local Notice to Mariners and Light List copies is still temporarily available, these printed products lack the positional accuracy of the electronic application and can therefore lead to relevant information being overlooked. From: 2026-10-19 To: 2026-12-01

Location:
Green Bay and Door Peninsula

Due to reduced resource availability, the Coast Guard will be decommissioning a number of aids in Green Bay, Sturgeon Bay and in vicinity of the Door Peninsula, significantly earlier than their advertised Light List dates. Early decommissioning is necessary to ensure that the Great Lakes Fall Retrieve Operation is completed prior to the end of the season, and to reduce the possible impacts to waterway restoration in the spring. Any questions or comments can be sent to the Federal Aids to Navigation Manager at the Coast Guard Great Lakes District via email at D09-DG-District-D9-LocalNoticetoMariners@uscg.mil.
